templates.label: B. subtilis — Del Norte project plasmid (PerR/PkatA)
templates.notes: Mirrors the team's own 4,791 bp B. subtilis plasmid. PerR is expressed from its own promoter and represses PkatA; peroxide oxidises PerR, derepressing PkatA, which drives RBS_st7 -> amyE signal peptide -> KanR -> endolysin -> GFP as one secreted cassette. pUB110 ori (dn_pub110_ori) already carries its own repB/RepU gene internally - no separate rep slot needed.

slots.note: positions 1-1524 in the team's plasmid; self-sufficient pUB110 dso+repB fragment (verified, GenBank OP555912.1:1305-2834)
1525-1910; drives the PerR repressor
1911-2244; PerR represses PkatA until oxidised by H2O2
2245-2298; insulates the PerR module from PkatA
2299-2364; PerR-repressed, peroxide-inducible. Carries a perfect 7/7 PerR box
2365-2391; includes the ATG, so the signal peptide that follows adds a second Met
2392-2490; amyE Sec signal, cleaved after Ala33
2491-2502; in-frame Ala-Cys-Ser-Ala junction to the marker
2503-3312; APH(3')-Ia, secreted as part of the fusion
3313-4023; defaults to the Lysqdvp001 endolysin, replaced by whatever gene of interest you pick
4024-4737; GFP readout
4738-4791; the wrecked-stem variant, distinct from the intact dn_perr_terminator at 2245-2298. Named 'T7 Terminator' in the team's map but it is not the T7 terminator.
